messages.author: 2d843ac3fd66a2ee
messages.subject: Spatial hurdle model for spatial area data
parts: Hi everyone, I'm trying to fit a spatial hurdle model with lattice data but I can't seem to execute it properly. Do you have a nice example or documentation where this was used? Thank you!

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Spatial hurdle model for spatial area data
parts:
Hi,

one type of hurdle model is shown in the
https://inlabru-org.github.io/inlabru/articles/zip_zap_models.html
vignette, where the ZAP example is a full hurdle model for 0/1 and
zero-truncated Poisson.

Finn
